    // Derived quantities on the univariate summary records of `statistics.types.plato`.

    //
    // Scope: only relations that follow from the field definitions by identity —
    // bin geometry, the algebraic identities among the moment fields, and the

    //==
    // # Histogram
    //
    // Convention, restated from the type: Counts[i] tallies the half-open bin
    // [Start + i*w, Start + (i+1)*w) where w is the Range extent over the bin
    // count, and the FINAL bin additionally includes the Range End.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Histogram

    // The number of bins.
    BinCount(self: Histogram): Integer
        => self.Counts.Count;
